hypothesis_summary: Extracting monolithic inline MCP tool definitions from src/mcp_server.ts into a modular src/mcp_tools/ directory will drastically reduce the Cognitive Complexity of the orchestration kernel without violating the JSON-RPC Stdio contract.
justification_or_plan: 1. Create directory `src/mcp_tools/`. 2. Incrementally extract individual tools (e.g., retrieve_scar_archive, update_dax_ssr) into separate files exporting a setup/registration function or configuration object. 3. Refactor `src/mcp_server.ts` to import these configurations and register them cleanly. 4. Verify TypeScript compilation and MCP standard I/O communication.
